title: Chapter 335 Fenglin County Was Destroyed
content:
Chapter 335 Fenglin County Was Destroyed

The assembly bell rang.

Wang Shuo calmed down and led the coalition forces from Changping County towards the gathering place.

During this expedition, Zhao Bangde recruited a total of 200,000 troops, of which Shanhai City's troops accounted for a quarter.

The main reason is that the armies of other lords have suffered too much damage in the battle, and many lords are no longer able to fight anymore and must go back to replenish their manpower.

Zhao Bangde decided to go to support Nanxuan Mansion first.

The transmission efficiency of Shanhai City is much higher than that of the county town.

Wang Shuo's Red Flame Army was arranged in the second wave.

Soon it was the Red Flame Army's turn to teleport.

Wang Shuo led the Hell Knights to the teleportation array first, and after a flash of white light.

Wang Shuo and others appeared in Nanxuan Mansion.

At this time, Nanxuan Mansion was already in the flames of war.

Zhao Bangde, the first batch of people sent over, had already discussed it with Zhu Dongheng, the governor of Nanxuan Mansion.

The supporting troops will gradually take over the defense task of the South City Gate.

Wang Shuo waited until the Red Flame Army and the coalition forces from Changping County were teleported over, and then he led everyone towards the defensive area.

On the city wall, the skeleton attack force was not strong.

But the bones piled up under the city showed that the previous battle was still very tragic.

Opposite, the undead army is still gathering.

They may also be waiting for reinforcements.

…

In a small hall in Nanxuan Mansion.

Zhu Dongheng and Zhao Bond were sitting at a small table.

"Governor Zhao, thank you so much this time."

"Between you and me, there is no need to be polite."

"Hey, now that Nanxuan Mansion is under siege, the situation is not optimistic."

While the two were drinking tea and chatting, Fenglin County sent a message asking for help.

Zhao Bond frowned.

The governor of Fenglin County is called Baichuan Zhonggu. When the three of them met before, Baichuan Zhonggu was arrogant and did not take the two of them seriously.

Therefore, Zhao Bondang did not choose to support Fenglin County.

At this time, after receiving the message asking for help, both of them were a little embarrassed. If they mobilized their manpower, I am afraid that the undead army outside Nanxuan Mansion would immediately launch a general attack.

The two discussed for a while and decided to send someone to check the situation.

Zhao Bangde called Ba Huoyao and Commander Ba in, intending to ask him to take people over to check it out.

After Commander Batong took the order, he had not yet stepped into the teleportation array.

I heard the system prompt sound.

[Fenglin County was captured by the undead army, and Baichuan Zhonggu died in the battle. 】

This message has been received by everyone!

Humanity lost an important city.

There were no remaining soldiers from Fenglin County teleported over from the teleportation array.

Obviously, the teleportation array has been occupied by the undead first.

I am afraid that most of the human soldiers in Fenglin County have become turtles in the urn, and I don’t know how many of them can escape.

Many lords couldn't help but worry about these hundreds of thousands of people.

At this time, Fenglin County was shrouded in death aura.

There was not a single living person in the entire city, corpses were everywhere, and rivers of blood flowed.

The blood seeped into the ground and was absorbed by the altar of the undead outside the city.

The altar of the undead outside the city underwent tremendous changes after absorbing enough blood.

"Ha ha……"

I finally came out.

A black dragon was summoned from the altar.

The Black Dragon King has completely abandoned the human body and transformed into a dragon form with teeth and claws.

His whole body was shrouded in black death aura, and after a burst of wild laughter, the Black Dragon King landed.

Beside the altar of the dead, Arif Ubol knelt on the ground and buried his head low.

"Please, Lord, punish me."

"It doesn't matter. I already know the battle process in Shanhai City. The power of the 'Destroying Souls of the Undead' formation is extraordinary. The battle is not your fault."

A majestic voice came from the mouth of the black shadow dragon.

Although the main force of the Burning Legion was destroyed, there were still some remnants left, and given time, they could still be rebuilt.

"The battle in Fenglin County is over. We will set off immediately to Nanxuan Mansion. As long as we capture this place, my strength will be further improved."

The Black Dragon King is confident.
